description:
perform_request inlines a response-size check using SafeFeedProcessor::MAX_FEED_SIZE. This is a feed-parsing concern, not an HTTP-client concern. CrestHttpClient should be feed-agnostic. The size guard belongs near SafeFeedProcessor or in the orchestrating Fetcher class. Either:
(a) Return the raw response and let fetcher.cr check size before invoking SafeFeedProcessor
(b) Inject a post-response hook in perform_request
Prefer (a) — moves the dependency out of crest_http_client.cr entirely.
title: Move SafeFeedProcessor size check out of CrestHttpClient
